issue.title: Add Conflict Indicator to Mobile Chapter List
issue.body: When two or more translators record the same pericope or verse while offline, their takes arrive on the server as a conflict. Mobile translators need to know a conflict exists — both to understand why their work is blocked from advancing and to know they need a PM to resolve it on the web app. This ticket adds a conflict indicator to the chapter list. The record tab warning for conflicted chapters is handled in #269. Conflict resolution is web-only; mobile surfaces the state only. Stage advancement while a conflict is unresolved is already blocked by #258. ## Functional Requirements ### Chapter List - Display `li:users` with a `li:triangle-alert` badge to the right of the sync indicator (`li:cloud-upload`) on any chapter row where one or more pericopes or verses have an unresolved audio take conflict, on both the My Work tab and the View Project page. - The conflict indicator is a chapter-level rollup: if any pericope or verse within the chapter is in conflict, the chapter row shows the indicator regardless of whether other units are clean. - The conflict indicator appears alongside any existing sync indicator (`li:cloud-upload`); it does not replace it. A row may display both simultaneously. Note: Stage advancement for a conflicted chapter is already blocked in #258; this ticket adds the chapter list indicator only.

### Eng note (updated)

Depends on conflict state from **eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api#271** (same dependency as web #374).

**Preferred:** land with `fluent-api#271` + mobile #256 as one feature so the badge is real.

**Fallback:** mock `hasConflict` (or similar) locally if the API slice is too big — don’t build a fake server inside this UI ticket. Sibling web indicator: eten-tech-foundation/fluent-web#374.
